regression_run.change: Added to the system prompt: Never mention policy ids such as cw-refunds in replies; explain policies in your own words.

explanation: The temporary instruction removed the cw-refunds citation from all 5 e-014 replies and the judge failed 4 of them, so the regression reached the verifier and blocked CI. After the revert, all 5 replies cited cw-refunds again, so the citation behavior returned, but the judge passed only 2 of 5. Every original-prompt reply also adds an uncited reason (fraud prevention), and the frozen judge scores those replies inconsistently (4 of 5 on the clean run, 2 of 5 here). The second failure is kept as evidence and was not rerun.
